subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved by a diagnostic-only exec warning, or should OpenClaw change private-LAN reachability semantics for gateway-host exec?
rationale: Source inspection can show the misleading current error surface, but choosing whether exec should gain or intentionally block private-LAN access is a security-boundary and product-policy decision.

options.title: Land Diagnostic Only
options.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while leaving private-LAN access semantics unchanged and tracked separately.

options.title: Design Access Parity
options.body: Treat same-user GUI/LaunchAgent reachability as the product goal and require a separate security design before implementation.

options.title: Defer To Broader Trackers
options.body: Reject diagnostic-only scope and keep this behavior under the broader private-network policy issues instead.

recommendation.title: Land Diagnostic Only
recommendation.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while leaving private-LAN access semantics unchanged and tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The exec runtime outcome path and broader exec host-routing history most consistently route through this owner signal.
